title: Dhyana & Samadhi
description: Journey into the highest stages of yoga, exploring the profound states of meditative absorption where the observer and the observed become one.

sutra.meaning: When there's a sense of effortless linkage of the attention to a particular region in the mind or to the emotions or to a higher dimension, it is the highest stage of yoga, that of samadhi. This is experienced as illumination of the higher self while the yogi feels as if devoid of his conditioned self.

sections.insight: When the seer and the seen appear to merge it is a state of samadhi.  Artists of all kinds when totally engrossed in their art would likely experience such a state. But an artist puts in a lot of effort in his art to reach such a state and is also not able to sustain it in his day to day life. The yogi on the other hand, who has lost the "i" ness seamlessly flows into it.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Have I experienced moments of samadhi in my practice?
sections.practice: Work at something you love with 100% attention and observe your mood afterwards

sections.wisdomFrom: Where the mind rests restrained by the practice of yoga, and where the self seeing the Self is delighted in the Self; and where established, the yogi knows that bliss which transcends the senses, which is understandable by the purified intellect only, and from the experience of Self does not even move; possessing which, he does not think any other gain greater than that; in which established he is not shaken even by great sorrow; that should be known by the term yoga, and that yoga which is free from sorrow should be attained by the undesponding and determined mind.

sutra.meaning: Practice and detachment can make one experience samadhi in four ways- i) Vitarka ,self-analysis, wherein one logically understands the 'Self' and experiences a shift within. ii) Vichara, synthesis of the senses and thought which brings about 'an awareness' without any disturbance iii) Ananda, bliss iv)  Asmita, only the experience of 'I am'

sections.insight:
It can be a gradual movement from one to the other or any one of the way. 
This is  Samprajnata Samadhi wherein there is still, distinction between the seer and the seen.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I need to rationally understand the process or am willing to sit for meditation and let go?
sections.practice: sit in meditation for 10 mins and observe your experience. Meditation evolves gradually. Give yourself time.
sections.journalPrompt: What do I feel in silence?
sections.wisdomFrom: Better than mechanical practice is knowledge; better than knowledge is meditation. Better than meditation is renunciation of the fruits of actions, for peace immediately follows such renunciation.

sections.theme: Dissolution of all save the Self

sutra.meaning: Asamprajnat-Samadhi is the other kind of Samadhi which is attained by the constant practice of cessation of all mental modifications, in which the Chitta retains only the unmanifested impression.

sections.insight: This state is akin to the state just before falling asleep. The intelligence dissolves but the sense of self remains.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I close to stopping the modulations of the mind to some extent?
sections.practice: Intensify your practices to quiten the mind.

sections.theme: The consciousness is freed of all disturbance.

sutra.meaning: In Asamprajnat Samadhi the sadhak may experience bodilessness or become merged in nature leading to solitude.

sections.insight: In this samadhi the sadhak is freed from all modulations but the samskaras spring back to life the moment he comes out of this state.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I open to this kind of experience yet?
sections.practice: Intensify your practices to quiten the mind.
sections.gurudevInsight:
Samadhi is not a property of just this level of existence. It goes into the other worlds also. People who do not have body, they too can get affected by the Meditation. When you meditate, you are not just bringing a harmony within your Self but you are influencing the subtle layers of creation. So your meditation influences those people who lived 100 years ago, their consciousness, and their mind, people who would live in the future, their mind, their consciousness too. Because life is infinite.  So there are different types of Yogi’s, one is called videha means one who do not have body. You can walk feeling as though you have no body & the mind is in such a state of equanimity. And those who do not have body are also coming in the influence or effect of yoga.
Same with Prakritilaya: - Those who are completely submerged in the
nature. They also attain the same state of equanimity. When you are looking at a Mountain or a sunset, what is happening? prakritilaya is happening, you are merging with that nature at that moment. 
But when you are doing that & if the mind comes, oh! this is water, what am I doing? Am I
not a stupid person looking here to the water? I should better use my time doing something
else. Or something else comes in mind, then you are not dissolving in nature. This is again a
big practice, prakritilaya is a big practice for hours together, for years together, people sit in
solitude just watch & watch & watch till all thoughts disappear. And all that they are left
with is emptiness.
And videha means knowing that I’m not the body, I have a body. This is my
body; I’m not the body. This is Videha.

sutra.meaning: Practice must be persued with faith,confidence, energy, keenness of memory and the power to absorb to avoid spiritual complacency.

sections.insight: I need to put in my 100% to make progress
sections.reflectionPrompt: Inner growth needs sincerity and effort. Am I a willing sadhak?
sections.practice: Be 100% present in whatever you do today
sections.meditation: 5 mins total focus on breath meditate 20 min
sections.journalPrompt: Do I have trust in the path?
sections.gurudevInsight:
"Shraddha means faith. Faith creates such a quality in your conociousness. It makes your consciousness stable, steady, solid. Doubt in consciousness makes you very vulnerable, fearful, uncertain, fluid.
Veerya :- it is 100% vigor or force, courage, vitality, total courage, the force with which
an army personal goes, valor, the valor with which army fights ...thrill is a sense of veerya, valor. The entire body, every cell in the body gets united, the whole consciousness becomes one. Defense system gets awakened in you. That is again a strength, defense against fear. That sense of patriotism or valor or vigor, also takes you to a state of Meditation.
 Smruti: means memory of it. Once who have had a very peaceful, beautiful state of mind
experience, the very memory of it again, will again make you re-live that. Memory of Samadhi reproduces, memory of one’s Being, memory of the
Self, memory of freedom, memory of devotion, memory of Surrender, memory of love,
memory of joy, brings back you to your Self."

sutra.meaning:
Intense effort brings quick progress
Effort varies in intensity -i) feeble ii) moderate iii)steady

sections.insight:
Depth of desire determines growth.
The pace of growth depends on your effort.
sections.reflectionPrompt:
How strong is my intention?
Where am I on this scale?
sections.practice:
Act with intensity in all you do today.
Observe effort level
sections.gurudevInsight:
"Often what we do, we keep 3rd-4th or 5th
preference to our practice. First preference we give to worldly things, our survival,
everything & last preference to anything that is spiritual. Then it will go slow. Then all other things will be around that. Do you see what I’m saying? Your first & foremost commitment in life
is to be with the truth, to evolve in truth. Then our work, other things - social obligations everything comes 2nd, 3rd, 4th like that & the list of preferences. Then it is very easy to you.
Very easy for one who gives it first preference, for one whose
mind is really wanting to move in this direction. Even then, there are three types:
mrudumadhyadheemamatratvatatodapivishesh:there also speciality is – mrudu means
little slow and medium & fast - says slow, medium & fast. People with three cycles. Ok, let
me do it, no no I have to do it & I cannot be without doing it, Do you see that? Someone who is really, really 100% into it, someone who is a little mild about it & someone says Ok! let me do this I have to do it. 1st, 2nd & 3rd grade."

sections.theme: Ultimate goal is the supreme divinity.

sutra.meaning:
The Chitta ie consciousness may be totaly focused and surrendered to God.
Ishvara is untouched by suffering and karma

sections.insight: The divine is pure and unaffected. The purpose of human life is to reach that state.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What is beyond the noise?
sections.meditation: 5 min awareness and surrender meditate 20 min
sections.gurudevInsight:
"“Ishwarapranidhandva” Just by devotion to God, just by one pointed
devotion to god, also possible.
Now,  it’s easy to say surrender to god, but what is God? 
What is it that rules this world? You would find it’s love that rules the world; the center core of the existence rules this whole universe. Like the Sun is the center of the solar system & it rules all the planets, like that the very center core of your life is ruled by Love. Beyond your changing body, beyond your changing thoughts, beyond your changing feelings, the very center core of your existence is very subtle, very delicate. You can call it love or anything. That consciousness, the core of existence, is responsible for this whole creation.
Patanjali in the next sutra very beautifully analyzes, what is that state of consciousness? Who is that who is Lord? That consciousness is free from misery and suffering. What  suffering?
Kleshakarmavipakashayerparamrusta purushvishesh ishwara. Five types of sufferings.  These five Kleshas (Sufferings) when they are eliminated even from the circumference, then whatever is in the
center becomes so eminent, so obvious, the Lordship in you blossoms."

sections.theme: One way is by sound vibrations.

sutra.meaning:
Om is the expression of the divine
Repeat Om with awareness

sections.insight:
Sound connects to consciousness because it is at the source of all creation. Aum is the symbol of divinity.
Repetition deepens experience.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I feel the vibrations of the sounds around me?
sections.practice: Chant Om 11 times watching the vibrations it makes within
sections.shlokaFrom:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥ 8.5 ॥
sections.wisdomFrom: One who departs from the body while remembering Me, the Supreme Personality, and chanting the syllable Om, will attain the supreme goal.
sections.gurudevInsight:
"Om is the nearest sound that could be addressed, that it could be addressed with. Because when you say Om, the prana, or the consciousness is total. Om is the sound, which is so special,
which is the nearest sound that could be used to address this totality of consciousness. “AAA” you say, the prana is in the lower portion of the body, “UUU” it’s the middle portion, “MMM” it’s in the top portion. When you say ‘Om’ the prana is total, complete. The Om’s distorted form is Amen-in Christian – Amen or Ameen in Islam,
That’s why Om is the one sound which is accepted by all the religions in the world –Buddhism, Jainism, Sikhism whatever religion that is there is in the world they all have a word which is Om or very close to Om. So ‘OM’ is the one sound, which comes very close to this totality of consciousness. All other names are just the periphery."

sutra.meaning: Om chanting leads inward and removes obstacles

sections.insight: Inner connection ie. when the experiencer, the experience and the experienced become one there is no inner or outer turmoil.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I able to go inwards when I sit in silence with eyes closed?
sections.practice: Observe your thoughts. Does that quieten them
sections.shlokaFrom:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्य: |

sections.wisdomFrom: God is Omniscient, the most ancient One, the Controller, subtler than the subtlest, the Support of all, and the possessor of an inconceivable divine form; He is brighter than the sun, and beyond all darkness of ignorance. One who at the time of death, with unmoving mind attained by the practice of Yog, fixes the prāṇ (life-airs) between the eyebrows, and steadily remembers the Divine Lord with great devotion, certainly attains Him.
sections.gurudevInsight:
"Sound ‘OM’ reminds you of the Lord, of the
creation.
“Tatah pratyekchetnadhigmonapyantrayamavasch” What is the use of it? When this
feeling of elevation, totality of consciousness coming to the core of your existence comes to you, then witness consciousness dawns in you, a different form of consciousness happens in you, your mind gets totally transformed, clarity begins in your thinking, clarity begins in your feelings, the whole body undergoes a transformation. So alive & full of prana & all the obstacles gets removed from your way. Just the memory of the Lordship, of the Divine can
remove obstacles from your way."

sections.theme: Another way is through focus on something.

sutra.meaning: Meditate on an object of your choice which is spiritually uplifting to you

sections.insight: Any sincere focus leads inward. This method of meditation by Patanjali in this group is seemingly the simplest but actually the hardest. Meditating on ones', self which is of course the most pleasant object to everyone, is the simplest and also the most difficult.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What inspires me?
sections.practice: Meditate at a chosen spot focusing within.

sections.theme: The smallest to the largest  are all within the purview.

sutra.meaning: Mastery extends from smallest to largest

sections.insight: Awareness expands limitlessly. Maharishi Patanjali has given various methods of dhyan or meditation  to master ones chitta or cosciousness and stop the desires from overtaking the mind.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Where can I expand awareness?
sections.gurudevInsight: What is the sign of progress in Meditation? “Parmanuparatmahatvaantosya vashikaar” From the smaller than the smallest, to the bigger than the biggest comes within his preview of operation. Then Nature loves you, start supporting you. From the atom - smaller than the smallest to the bigger than the biggest comes with in your preview of operation on life.

sections.theme: Purity of mind is the aim.

sutra.meaning: When the seer the seen and the instrument of perception become one, the mind becomes clear and it reflects reality like a crystal

sections.insight:
When the mind is pure it reflects truth without distortion.This is a very refined state of consciousness called samapatti. 
Thus yoga and samadhi are but means to reach the state of samapatti.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Is my perception clear or colored?
sections.gurudevInsight:
The consciousness which grabs or which holds and the object which it holds & the senses
through which it holds, all the three are in harmony, that is samadhi. Do you get this point?
One who is seeing, the mind, the Self which is seeing, he is in harmony, the senses are in harmony, eyes are the instrument through which you hold the seeing, ears are the instrument
through which you hold the sound. So your ears, sound & from where the sound is coming,
whoever is speaking all the three connected, they all become keen & crystal clear. When can
that happen? When your mind is not going on your own trip of regret & anger, anticipation,
sleep, proof, wrong knowledge, fantasy & Memory a five modulations. You know when you
look at a mountain, you don’t just look at the mountain oh, this is beautiful mountain.
Immediately mind says Oh! This is beautiful but then it doesn’t stop there,- this is
beautiful. Oh, this is like Canada or like Himalayas,- immediately something is added to it. So
you are not seeing things as they are but you are seeing through memory, seeing through
comparison. That is no samadhi.

sutra.meaning: Savitarka samapatti wherein perception words, their meaning simultaneously blend with understanding into a special knowledge. .

sections.insight: The sadhaks chitta has become clear like a mirror and there are no boundaries to understanding.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Where do I over-interpret?

sections.theme: Memory is the grime on the mirror.

sutra.meaning: When memory is purified only truth shines Let go of past filters to see clearly.

sections.insight: Past impressions create biases and prejudices. Unless the slate is continuously cleaned the writing on top will be garbled.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I think too much of what has passed. Is my perception colored by past experiences.
sections.gurudevInsight:
There is another type of samadhi where in you are not aware of anything, just you
know that you are. That’s it. This is eyes closed Meditation. When your eyes are closed you
simply know you are, but you don’t know where you are, what you are, who you are, as
though you are not there at all. But just there is a abhaas, just there is a feeling you are,
nothing more than the feeling that I am. This he calls Nirvichara samadhi (Nirvitarka
Samadhi).

sutra.sanskrit: एतयैव सविचारा निर्विचारा च सूक्ष्मविषया व्याख्याता
sutra.meaning: Awareness refines from subte to the subtlest when the sadhak moves from savichar samapatti to nirvichar samapatti.

sections.insight: Subtle states of awareness deepen perception when from meditating on  oneself or objects of the senses etc the sadhak withdraws to contemplate beyond space and time or cause and effect.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I notice subtle feelings?

sutra.meaning: Nature at its subtlest is consciousness. When the two dissolve into one it is at its purest.

sections.insight: Awareness expands beyond form. There is total cessation of the modulations of the small mind and the appearance of the Cosmic Mind or mahat.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I go beyond labels?

sections.theme: The intellect needs to dissolve too.

sutra.meaning: These are seed-based meditations, ie the sadhak's intellect or buddhi is still in play.

sections.insight: The six samapattis mentioned viz. savitarka, nirvitarka, savichara, nirvichara , ananda and asmita are all sabeej (or seeded in nature).
sections.reflectionPrompt: What patterns remain?
sections.gurudevInsight:
"There are two types of samadhi, One, Samadhi is that you experience during activity i.e.
sabheej samadhi. As a child you would be doing this, you have done this. Have you noticed
a child? Its eyes are not flittering around here & there. It is very steady. A child stares at
things & there is depth in the eye of a child. It indicates the soul, how steady & stable the soul is. Eyes are the window for you to see the world & the world to see your soul how
steady it is. This is the job of the senses. It gives you the knowledge of the world to
you & it gives the knowledge of you to the world. And when we polish this, make it hollow
& empty, hollow & empty, it becomes like a crystal. The soul in you reflects the dignity, the
lord, the senses in you reflects that soul, that lordship in you. Then you look at the flower,
you are not just looking at the flower, you are touching the flower, you are feeling the flower,
you are listening to the flower, all your senses become totally active, like the crystal which
reflects the purusha inside you, Being in you, the senses & the object of the senses, reflect
one Divinity. This is sabheej Samadhi.  You look at the
mountain, the mountain reminds you of the Self, of the consciousness. . That very moment samadhi is happening to you, you
are in samadhi. You are looking at a sunset & then you are in samadhi because the mind is
steady, senses are steady. Steadiness is dignity. Steadiness is the strength & steadiness is
dispassion. You can experiment this. For a few moments you keep your body steady & keep
your eyes steady & you will see almost immediately the mind will also become steady; mind will become still & the breath will become still. This is when the
time stops, death stops, immortality begins. Before the time swallows you, before this earth
gulps you, you wake up, you swallow the time. That is samadhi. Got it? Samadhi is a state
where you feel you can stay like this for a million years. Samadhi is a state where the mind
freezes. Like you keep vegetables, fruits in friz & it stay fresh forever. Samadhi is a
refrigeration of your life, secret of youthfulness, secret of bubbling enthusiasm, secret of
renewal of life. . Every
experience of your senses, what you see becomes very bright colorful, complete. you know usually what happens, when we are happy? We feel expanded.
Have you observed what is your feeling when you’ve happy? When you are happy, what
happens? You feel you are floating some thing in you is expanding, you don’t feel the body, you feel just an expansion. And what happen when you are sad, uptight,
sorrowful? Contraction, tightness, reduction, isn’t it? Also when we feel expanded, our
awareness is expanding, we tend to fall asleep. And when we want to have keenness of
awareness, we seem to be more uptight, not relaxed. See, if you have to have a thread go
through a needle, it takes really good alertness to do that, right? Half sleepy person or
somebody who is drowsy, or someone who is a drunkard, cannot do that,  At the same time when your awareness is expanded, there is no keenness of awareness
& when there is keenness of awareness, there is no relaxation, there is no expansion of
awareness. The combination of both this i.e. you are totally relaxed, happy & expanded & at
the same time have that sharpness of awareness, sharpness of intelligence. That is sabheej
samadhi. Your senses become so clear that it can perceive better, see better, think better, hear
better.  And same thing with seeing. People don’t see,. We are insensitive to people, this is another thing because we don’t see, we don’t
hear properly; we are totally insensitive to people’s feelings. Samadhi is sensitive to others
feelings too. When you become sensitive, when this instrument here becomes sensitive. the
world, the nature becomes sensitive to you, nature listens to you. How can this happen?
"

sutra.meaning: Nirvichar or non Reflection brings clarity in subtle awareness and inner joy

sections.insight: When the chitta (consciousness) and buddhi (intellect) remain non reflective inner clarity blossoms and brings calm and happiness.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Did I feel inner ease?
sections.gurudevInsight:
More and more experience of thoughtless state of mind brings adhyatma prasada, grace of the
Divine in life, grace of the soul gets manifested. Adhyatma prasada. Spiritual awakening,
spiritual blossoming happens if more & more hollow & empty.

sutra.meaning: Seasoned wisdom arises in the chitta (consciousness) and provides immense insight.

sections.insight: Inner wisdom is beyond logic and human intellect.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Did insight arise naturally?
sections.gurudevInsight:
That awareness is a special knowledge, Ritambara - Intuitive knowledge, the
knowledge, which is flawless, which is beyond time, which is steady & which is benevolent,
Ritambara - full of truth, truth state of consciousness, that’s what is Ritambara

sections.theme: Its a different kind of wisdom.

sutra.meaning: This wisdom differs from knowledge gained externally

sections.insight: Direct experience is different from learned knowledge.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Did I experience or just think?
sections.gurudevInsight:
"The knowledge which comes from
the depth of the being is different from the one which you read, which you have heard or
which you guess through the intellect. 
The impression of that state of consciousness can wipe out all other impressions in the mind,
which are useless, which are not necessary for life. To some degree, this keeps happening to
all. May be 5% or 10%, 50%, 15%, 20%, 80%. Very first sitting of Meditation, when you
have started, see it erases something of the past, deeper you go, more hollow & empty, you
feel a new person, different person. Many people come up with this experience Oh! I feel
totally different, changed; I am not the old person, what has happened? It has removed,
erased, other sanskaras, other impression from the mind. It has made you new; it renews you
again & again. & again. Often you would experience that when you remember the past, you
feel oh, you are not the same person or that was not you as though you are not at all
connected to those events & that person who did those jobs. 
Whatever you did 15-20 years ago, now you turn back & see you’ll wonder, am I the same
person.? I didn’t do it, somebody else did it, why? Because this sanskara of pure
consciouness erased those things of your past & makes you a new person every time, every
day, This is pure knowledge. If someone holds you on to something you did in the
past, you just laugh at them because you are not the same person now. You see it as though
somebody else did it. "

sutra.sanskrit:
तज्जः संस्कारोऽन्यसंस्कारप्रतिबन्धी
तस्यापि निरोधे सर्वनिरोधान्निर्बीजः समाधिः
sutra.meaning:
New impressions are prevented whereas old patterns are erased.
Even this new state of wisdom dissolves leading to a nirbeeja or seedless state

sections.insight:
Awareness replaces conditioning.
Ultimate stillness is beyond all patterns.
sections.reflectionPrompt:
What pattern shifted?
Can I rest without effort?
sections.gurudevInsight:
"samadhi where even the feeling of some impression is not there & there is no end to it.
There are many different states of awareness, types of samadhi being described. The path is
long & every step is complete in itself. It’s not that you are aiming at a goal after some time.
The goal is in every moment, yet the path is long. Do you get it? The path is very long yet
the goal is at every moment, the goal is at where you are. 
Those who are very enthusiastic, they have no patience. People who have
patience are very lethargic. They say, ok we will do it, may be next lifetime. Others are
restless & they want to do right now. Do you see this? You can see this every step,
everywhere, you can see every one, either they are on this extreme or that extreme. See, you
can have a sleep but you cannot have a quick sleep, hurried sleep in not possible. You cannot say I am in a hurry; I should quickly sleep & go. Ok! Try to quickly sleep. 10 minutes of
Short rest – quick, hurry. Not possible, do you see that?  same with Meditation. You cannot say, i am going to have quick Meditation, I have
no time, I want to have quick meditation - not possible.
So this path is a middle path, Golden path, where you are enthusiastic, you are in a
hurry & at the same time you are patient, you are patient & at the same time you are not
lethargic, you are not postponing things. Often when people have to do something good,
something for their personal development, they say, if God willing I will do it, God willing it
will come to me, they leave it to God when it comes to ones practices, development. But if
you have to do something in the world, something we have to do, they don’t say God willing
I will make a house, if God willing I will have a relationship, you don’t do that, you look for
relationship, you look for house, you look for job, look for money, for that you put your
100%. But if you have to do something for your growth, you say, God willing, it will happen.  It should be the other way around. So patience & dynamism, enthusiasm is the golden rule."

sutra.meaning: Subtle impressions dissolve by returning to source.Meditation removes disturbances

sections.insight: Going inward dissolves patterns.Meditation clears mind patterns.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I go inward?Did meditation help?
